title: When gratitude feels thin
issueStatement: The day may still contain mercy, but the heart has narrowed itself around what is missing, delayed, or undeservedly difficult.
centralInsight: Gurbani restores gratitude by returning the soul to gift, mercy, and Naam rather than asking for a performance of positivity.
practicalReflection: Gratitude is not a bright mood pasted over pain. It is truthful recognition that you are still being carried, guided, and given more than you can manufacture for yourself.
actionPrompt: Name one mercy beneath the surface event today, and stay with it long enough for entitlement to loosen.
